evaluation_protocol.implementation: Ultralytics DetectionValidator with captured per-image TP rows
evaluation_protocol.matching: Ultralytics greedy per-image same-class matching; multi_label=True NMS
evaluation_protocol.p_values: two-sided paired bootstrap; Holm-Bonferroni for three enhancement methods x two metrics

limitations: Bootstrap intervals resample existing images; they do not create new domains or annotations.
test_clean is leakage-filtered but still shares source-level provenance with training data; image-level intervals may be too narrow.
The source-stem cluster bootstrap is a sensitivity analysis, not proof of source independence.

Overall mAP intervals require every evaluated class to have at least one ground-truth instance in the resample; finite_resamples reports how many of the requested resamples satisfy this. Rare-class per-class intervals and fraction_of_resamples_present are reported separately.
Enhancement comparisons use one checkpoint, one 399-image subset, and CPU inference.
Bootstrap p-values are approximate and are not a substitute for external validation.

test_full.overall_conditioning: overall metrics require every fixed class to have at least one ground-truth instance in the resample

test_clean.overall_conditioning: overall metrics require every fixed class to have at least one ground-truth instance in the resample

valid_full.overall_conditioning: overall metrics require every fixed class to have at least one ground-truth instance in the resample

enhancement.overall_conditioning: overall metrics require every fixed class to have at least one ground-truth instance in the resample
